acceptance: TestChannel_EndToEnd no longer depends on the stdout and stderr appends of tick 2 landing in one poll of the Normalizer
The test passes 200 times with -race -count=200 under a loaded host (or with a fake ticker that forces the worst interleaving)
A mutation that lets response_complete close the span before the assistant text is visible fails the test
fix: Drive the Normalizer with an injected tick (or wait for the feed to carry the assistant_text envelope before appending idle_reached), so the span always contains the assistant text; no sleeps.
summary: TestChannel_EndToEnd failed in CI with answer text "" after 0.01 s on a change that does not touch internal/bridge/channel. Tick 2 appends the assistant text to stdout and idle_reached to stderr; one poll can read stdout before the first append and stderr after the second, so response_complete closes the span before the assistant text exists. The test passes 5/5 locally.
title: TestChannel_EndToEnd races on tick 2: the span can close before the assistant text lands
